instruction: Give a 5-star rating to all songs in my Spotify playlists which I have liked. If I have already rated it lower, increase it to 5.
notes: Single-app task (spotify) plus supervisor. The target set is 'songs appearing in any of the supervisor's playlists AND liked by the supervisor'; it is encoded with static world facts (in-playlist ?s)/(liked ?s) that become usable only after the nullary knowledge flags (playlists-fetched)/(liked-fetched) are set by show_playlist_library/show_liked_songs (each action stands for the full paginated fetch). show_song_reviews(song_id, user_email=supervisor email) sets (reviews-checked ?s), after which either review_song (no existing review -> add a 5-star review) or update_song_review (existing lower review -> raise to 5) is applicable; (not (rated ?s ?r)) on the update guards against touching reviews already at 5 (song-d), matching the 'if rated lower' clause. Representative songs: song-a (add review), song-b (update review-b), song-c (in playlist but not liked -> untouched), song-d (already 5 -> untouched). Because supervisor-complete-task must carry the task-specific goal literals in its precondition without quantifiers, the goal-relevant songs and rating-5 are declared as domain :constants (the domain is task-specific anyway); the spotify app constant is likewise declared only in the domain and not redeclared in :objects to avoid duplicate-object errors in Fast Downward. The supervisor's email is a static (supervisor-email ?e) fact gated by (profile-known) from supervisor.show_profile, used both as the login username and as user_email for show_song_reviews. complete_task takes no answer (no question asked).
